starts.note: customer: start only when the customer asks about a referral they made or about a missing referral bonus. This job reads the records and explains each referral from them. It has two kinds of writes. (1) A transfer, made only after the customer agrees: for a persistent ERROR status, or for a rejection the records cannot explain. (2) A retry of a REJECTED referral whose rolling 7-day window has passed. The agent may tell the customer a retry is possible now. If the customer wants it, they resubmit with their own submit_referral tool. If they want a new shareable link instead, hand off to generating_a_credit_card_referral_link.
starts.quote: You can track the status of your referrals at any time through the Rho-Bank mobile app or by contacting customer service.

tools.not_used: Do not call this for the referred person. They are a different customer and are not verified in this conversation. The referral status comes from get_referrals_by_user, and the requirement comes from the card's referral program document.
Not needed. The status, card type and timestamps that decide whether a bonus is paid are all in the referral records from get_referrals_by_user.

Not used to look into an existing referral, and not needed for a plain retry, which the customer resubmits with submit_referral. It is given only inside generating_a_credit_card_referral_link, after that job's pre-checks, when the customer asks for a new shareable link. The customer runs it. Agents must not generate the link themselves.

This job gives no tool itself. If the customer asks for a new shareable link, customer_resubmit hands off to generating_a_credit_card_referral_link, which gives get_referral_link after its pre-checks. A plain retry uses the customer's own submit_referral, which needs no handover.

This is the customer's own tool. No referral or status document names it or tells the agent to direct or forbid its use, so this job never instructs the customer to run it. If the customer runs it on their own and asks again, recheck re-reads the referral status.

steps.do: Greet the customer politely and ask how you can help. Share no account information before the customer is verified.
steps.quote: Be polite and professional

steps.do: Ask for the customer's full name or email if they have not given it, then look up their record with get_user_information_by_name (the exact, case-sensitive name), get_user_information_by_email, or get_user_information_by_id if they give a user id. If no record is found, ask them to check the spelling or give another identifier.

args.customer_name: the name the customer gave (or use get_user_information_by_email / get_user_information_by_id with what they gave)

steps.quote: To verify the identity of the user, call the appropriate read tools, and ensure that they are able to give correctly any 2 out of the following values: date of birth, email, phone number, address.

steps.do: Ask for 2 of: date of birth, email, phone, address. Check them against the record. Share nothing about the customer before they are verified.
steps.quote: Knowing full name or userID is not enough to verify.

steps.do: Tell the customer you cannot verify their identity, so you cannot look up their referrals. Share no account details, and stop.
steps.if: fewer than 2 of the values the customer gave match the record
steps.quote: Do not leak any information about the user before they are verified.

steps.do: Get the current timestamp for the verification log. Use the same timestamp for any rolling 7-day window check later in this job.
steps.if: verification succeeded
steps.quote: If you need the current time, always use the get_current_time() tool.

steps.do: Log the verification record
steps.if: verification succeeded
steps.quote: After verification, you must call the verification logging tool to properly log the information into the verification records.

steps.do: Get all referrals the verified customer has made

steps.do: Only one referral is returned, so use it. Note its status and referred card type.
steps.if: exactly one referral is returned
steps.quote: You can track the status of your referrals at any time through the Rho-Bank mobile app or by contacting customer service.

steps.do: If there are several referrals, ask which one the customer means (for example the most recent one, where the friend was approved). Then note its status and card type.
steps.if: more than one referral is returned and the customer is asking about one particular referral (not about why only some of several referrals earned a bonus)
steps.quote: IN_PROGRESS — the referred person has successfully opened a new account and is in progress to meet the criteria for the referral bonus

steps.do: The customer asks about several referrals, for example why only some earned a bonus. Do not ask them to pick one. List every referral record with its status, card type and timestamp. Then run the matching explain_ step for each one, so each referral gets a specific reason from the records, not a list of general possibilities.
steps.if: more than one referral is returned and the customer asks about several of them or about missing bonuses across them
steps.quote: REJECTED: Do not retry immediately; review the user’s existing referral activity before advising next steps.

steps.do: Tell the customer you cannot find the referral they describe on their profile. Do not guess a status or invent a reason. Remind them that the friend must apply through their referral link for it to be tracked.
steps.if: get_referrals returns no referrals, or none matches the one the customer describes
steps.quote: When they use your link to apply and are approved, the referral will be tracked to your account.

steps.do: Find the referred card's own referral program document in the KB. Get its qualifying spend amount, time window, bonus and annual cap.
steps.quote: Each credit card type has its own referral bonus and eligibility requirements that are not detailed here.

steps.do: Tell the customer that the referred card has no documented referral offer, so you cannot confirm any bonus terms for it. Do not invent terms.
steps.if: the KB has no referral program document for the referred card type
steps.quote: Not all credit cards participate in the referral program.

steps.do: IN_PROGRESS: tell the customer the friend's account is open but has not yet met the bonus criteria, so no bonus is due yet. From the referral record, name the referred card type. From that card's program document, give the exact qualifying spend in dollars and the window counted from the referred account's opening (for example, Platinum Rewards Card: $1,500 within 90 days; Silver Rewards Card: $750 within 60 days; EcoCard: $500 within 60 days). Then give the bonus and the payout timing. Do not read the referred person's own transactions or accounts. No agent action is needed.
steps.if: status is IN_PROGRESS
steps.quote: IN_PROGRESS: No action required; monitor until criteria are met.

steps.do: Use the exact timestamps in get_referrals and the current time from get_time to count the COMPLETE referrals (all credit card types) in the 7 days before now. If there are already 2, tell the customer that a referral completing inside that rolling window will not qualify for a bonus. Tell them when the window ends: 7 days after the older of those two bonuses.
steps.if: status is IN_PROGRESS or APPLIED
steps.quote: This is calculated on a rolling 7-day basis, so if you've already had 2 referrals complete in the past week, any additional referrals during that time won't qualify for a bonus.

steps.do: Use get_referrals and the current year from get_time to count the customer's COMPLETE referrals for the referred card in this calendar year. Compare that count with the card's annual cap from its program document (e.g. EcoCard, Silver Rewards and Platinum Rewards 7; Business Silver 10; Business Gold 8; Business Platinum 11; Silver Zoom 10; Business Bronze and Green Rewards 7). If the cap is already reached, tell the customer that no further bonus can be earned for that card this calendar year.
steps.if: status is IN_PROGRESS or APPLIED
steps.quote: You can earn up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year

steps.do: COMPLETE: tell the customer the bonus will be granted under the card's program terms, and give the documented payout timing
steps.if: status is COMPLETE
steps.quote: COMPLETE: The bonus will be granted per the applicable referral program terms.

steps.do: NO_PROGRESS: tell the customer this referral shows no application yet. You may remind them that the invitee has not started an application.
steps.if: status is NO_PROGRESS
steps.quote: NO_PROGRESS: You may remind the referrer that the invitee has not started an application.

steps.do: APPLIED: explain that the application is awaiting a decision and no intervention is needed
steps.if: status is APPLIED
steps.quote: APPLIED: Await the application decision; no manual intervention is needed.

steps.do: For each REJECTED referral, use the exact timestamps in get_referrals to find the referral bonuses (COMPLETE, across all credit card types) that fell in the 7 days before it. Two of them mean it was auto-denied by the weekly limit. Then count the bonuses in the 7 days before the current time from get_time. Fewer than 2 means the window has passed. 2 or more means it is still active. Note when it ends: 7 days after the older of the two most recent bonuses.
steps.if: status is REJECTED
steps.quote: A rolling 7-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.

steps.do: REJECTED: check the customer's other referrals for the 2-per-rolling-7-day limit. Explain that the referral was auto-denied and cannot be reinstated in that window. Do not retry right away. Use rejected_window_check to name the specific referrals that filled the window.
steps.if: status is REJECTED
steps.quote: REJECTED: Do not retry immediately; review the user’s existing referral activity before advising next steps.

steps.do: A REJECTED referral may have fewer than 2 COMPLETE bonuses in the 7 days before it (rejected_window_check). If so, do not make up another reason. Use the status's documented meaning: the customer had too many referral processes going on. Name the other referral records in get_referrals whose timestamps fall within the 7 days around it, and tell the customer the next step from rejected_window_check: still_in_window or offer_retry. If the records show nothing that explains the rejection, say so plainly and offer a transfer to a human agent. Transfer only if the customer agrees, as explain_error does.
steps.if: status is REJECTED and rejected_window_check finds fewer than 2 referral bonuses in the 7 days before it
steps.quote: REJECTED — the user has too many referral processes going on

steps.do: Tell the customer the 7-day window has not passed yet, so a new attempt now would also be denied. Give the time it ends, from rejected_window_check. Do not suggest submitting again now.
steps.if: status is REJECTED and 2 or more referral bonuses still fall within the 7 days before the current time
steps.quote: Auto-denied referrals due to the limit cannot be reinstated within the same 7-day window.

steps.do: Tell the customer the 7-day window that caused the denial has passed, so they may now attempt the referral again for the same card type. Ask whether they want to.
steps.if: status is REJECTED and fewer than 2 referral bonuses fall within the 7 days before the current time
steps.quote: If a referral is denied for hitting the limit, wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap before attempting another.

steps.do: Count the open slots: 2 minus the number of COMPLETE credit card referral bonuses (all card types) timestamped in the 7 days before the current time. If the customer wants to retry more REJECTED referrals than there are open slots, explain the cap: 2 bonuses per rolling 7 days, shared across all cards. Ask which referral to retry first. Retry only as many as there are slots. Tell the customer when the next slot opens: 7 days after the older bonus in the window.
steps.if: the customer wants to retry more REJECTED referrals than there are open slots in the rolling 7-day window
steps.quote: This limit applies across all credit card types; referrals from different cards still count toward the same weekly cap.

steps.do: Before any new attempt, check again when the customer's last two successful referral bonuses landed (rejected_window_check, against the current time from get_time). If fewer than 2 fall in the 7 days before now, tell the customer they can resubmit the referral themselves with their own submit_referral tool. They pass their own user_id. For account_type they pass the card type exactly as written on the REJECTED referral record. The agent does not submit it for them. If no_card_program found no documented terms for that card, say you cannot confirm its bonus terms, but do not block the retry. If the customer asks for a new shareable link to send their friend instead, hand off to generating_a_credit_card_referral_link. That job runs its own pre-checks and then gives get_referral_link, which the customer runs themselves. Retry one referral at a time, because each new bonus counts toward the same 7-day cap.
steps.if: status is REJECTED, fewer than 2 referral bonuses fall within the 7 days before the current time, and the customer wants to retry
steps.quote: If a referral is denied for hitting the limit, wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap before attempting another.

steps.do: The customer resubmits the referral with their own submit_referral tool.

rules.quote: Auto-denied referrals due to the limit cannot be reinstated within the same 7-day window.

rules.quote: You can earn up to 7 referral bonuses per calendar year.

jobs.done_when:
All of the following hold:
- The customer is verified and the verification is logged, or the customer has been told they could not be verified.
- Their referrals have been retrieved.
- Either the referral in question has been identified, or, when the customer asked about several, every referral has been explained with its specific status and the reason the records show. If the referral could not be found, the customer has been told so.
- For IN_PROGRESS, the customer has heard the referred card's exact documented qualifying spend amount, the time window from account opening, and the bonus. They have also heard about any rolling 7-day or annual cap that would stop the bonus.
- For each REJECTED referral, the customer has heard which bonuses filled the 7-day window, and either when the window ends or that they may try again now.
- If they chose to retry: they resubmitted with submit_referral (or ran get_referral_link through the handoff), no more times than there were open slots and in the order they chose. The new status was then re-read and the result explained.
- Follow-up questions are answered. If the customer reported new purchases and asked again, the status was re-read.
- For a persistent ERROR, the customer has accepted or declined a transfer.

info.ask: Which card would you like to refer your friend for? (For the earlier rejected referral, it was the card shown in your referral record.)

info.about: which of the referrals the customer wants to retry come first, when there are more retries than open slots
info.ask: Right now only a limited number of referral bonuses can be received in the rolling 7-day window. Which referral would you like to retry first?

steps.do: Get the current time again if it has not just been read.
steps.if: the customer wants to retry a referral
steps.quote: A rolling 7-day window means the count is evaluated based on the exact timestamps of your most recent referral bonuses, not calendar weeks.

steps.do: Using the referral records and now, count the COMPLETE credit card referral bonuses in the 7 days before now. Open slots = 2 minus that count. If 0, tell the customer the new referral would be automatically denied, give the time when the oldest bonus will be more than 7 days old, and stop. Do not provide a tool and do not transfer.
steps.if: the customer wants to retry a referral
steps.quote: If no referral program is documented for the requested card, or if the user’s claimed terms are incorrect, or if there is reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected, explain why and do not provide a referral link tool. Do not transfer to a human in these cases.

steps.do: If the customer wants to retry more referrals than there are open slots, tell them the cap (2 bonuses per rolling 7 days, shared across all cards) and ask which referral comes first. Make only as many as there are slots.
steps.if: requested retries exceed open slots
steps.quote: This limit applies across all credit card types; referrals from different cards still count toward the same weekly cap.

steps.do: Search the knowledge base for a documented referral program for the card and restate its terms (bonus amount, qualifying spend, annual cap). Check the card's annual cap against the COMPLETE referrals for that card in the current calendar year. If the cap is reached, explain and stop. If no referral program is documented for the card, tell the customer, and do not give get_referral_link.
steps.if: the customer wants to retry a referral
steps.quote: Search the knowledge base to confirm the specific card has a documented referral program.

steps.do: Tell the customer they can resubmit the referral themselves with their submit_referral tool. They pass their own user id and the exact card name.

args.account_type: the exact card name from the rejected referral record, or the card the customer chose in r_order

steps.if: r_slots shows at least one open slot and the customer wants to resubmit a referral
steps.quote: If a referral is denied for hitting the limit, wait until enough time has passed to drop under the cap before attempting another.

steps.do: Give the customer the get_referral_link tool and explain that they run it with their own user_id and the exact card name. Do not generate the link for them.
steps.if: the customer asks for a referral link to share, r_slots shows an open slot, and r_program_check found a documented referral program for that card
steps.quote: Tell the customer to pass their own user_id and the exact card name (for example, 'Gold Rewards Card').

steps.do: The customer runs get_referral_link. On success, a referral record with status NO_PROGRESS is created.
steps.quote: When the tool is called successfully, a referral record is created with status 'NO_PROGRESS'.

steps.do: Optionally re-read the referrals to confirm the new referral record. If its status is ERROR, follow s_error. If it is REJECTED, re-run the window check and explain.
steps.if: the customer reports that they ran submit_referral or get_referral_link
steps.quote: ERROR: Retry later or escalate internally if the condition persists.

steps.do: Restate the documented terms for the card: the friend must be approved and meet the card's qualifying spend for the bonus to be paid.
steps.quote: Reiterate the correct referral terms as documented to prevent confusion and complaints.

rules.rule: Do not retry a REJECTED referral without first reviewing the customer's existing referral activity.
rules.quote: REJECTED: Do not retry immediately; review the user’s existing referral activity before advising next steps.

rules.rule: Do not provide a referral link tool if the card has no documented program or the referral would be auto-rejected. Do not transfer in these cases.
rules.quote: If no referral program is documented for the requested card, or if the user’s claimed terms are incorrect, or if there is reason to believe the referral will be automatically rejected, explain why and do not provide a referral link tool. Do not transfer to a human in these cases.

rules.rule: The agent never generates the referral link itself. The customer runs the tool.
rules.quote: Agents must not generate the link on the customer’s behalf.

rules.rule: Not every card participates in referrals.
rules.quote: Not all credit cards participate in the referral program. Before sharing your link, make sure the card you're referring has an active referral offer.

draft.done_when: Either the customer has resubmitted the referral (or generated a link) while a window slot was open and has been told the card's terms, or they have been told why a new referral would be auto-denied now and when they can try again.
